about_body: This book is a complete theological archive: fifty illustrated Bible volumes, four hundred questions about other faiths, eight journey maps across the Holy Land, one thousand short Bible study answers, one hundred hard questions with replies from five Christian traditions, a full atlas of angels and the Watchers, two hundred and forty seven prophecy notes, the story of the world's religions, the family line from Adam to Jesus, and the archive of Pakistani Christian music and podcasts. It is set in a traditional book size and laid out as open two-page spreads, the way a printed volume sits in the hand.
table_rows: The full Bible encyclopedia with tables and pictures
Eight journey maps with every stop named
Islam, Judaism, Hinduism and Sikhism, answered with care
Short Bible study questions sorted by book
One hundred tough questions, five Christian views each
Enoch, holy beings, beasts, and a picture gallery
Fulfillment notes, world religions, Adam to Jesus
Pakistani gospel singers, Punjabi Zaboor, episodes
Websites, questions and answers, Bible book counts
cover_lede: Fifty Bible-encyclopedia volumes, a 400-question faith codex, Bible maps, a 1,000-answer study archive, angels and prophecy, and the Punjabi Zaboor hymn collection
cover_note: Collected from the Saul's Podship project and set in print for study and devotion
